contradictions.what: Rep says there was no moment and nothing to do, yet describes a late analysis with fixable findings that the customer found most useful.
Rep calls the account healthy and off everyone's list, yet a new head of payments had been hired and was pulling declines without her knowing.
Rep says customer likes the product and nobody wanted to rip anything out, yet international business went to local acquiring.
Rep says we weren't really pitching, but she describes answering with the Authorization Boost deck and a roadmap offer.
Rep says it was decided before she got in the room, but she also describes the analysis arriving after the question and the CFO decision being two weeks before the last call.

dodges.question: Which ones? (which international markets looked bad)
dodges.what: Said she doesn't know exactly; named Brazil and a couple in Europe; never saw the analysis.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Reframed as 'not really pitching' and offered product-satisfaction generalities before naming silence on uplift.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Answered 'no moment' and 'not sure there was anything to do', later contradicted by the late analysis and 'I heard from Stripe when I said I was leaving'.

dodges.question: When was the last business review before that?
dodges.what: Hesitated and gave a hedged '9? 10?' months, tied to before she took the account.
